@@ -195,6 +195,93 @@ def test_get_submission_attributes():
         get_submission_attributes(11111, new_submission_data)
 
 
+def _submission_data(cgac_code, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, is_quarter_format=True, frec_code='0000'):
+    return {
+        'cgac_code': cgac_code,
+        'frec_code': frec_code,
+        'reporting_fiscal_year': fiscal_year,
+        'reporting_fiscal_period': fiscal_period,
+        'is_quarter_format': is_quarter_format,
+        'publishable': False,
+        'number_of_errors': 0,
+        'reporting_start_date': datetime.date(2017, 1, 1),
+        'reporting_end_date': datetime.date(2017, 3, 31),
+        'updated_at': datetime.datetime(2017, 4, 10, 12, 0, 0),
+    }
+
+
+def _submission_record(cgac_code, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, is_quarter_format=True):
+    return SubmissionAttributes.objects.create(
+        broker_submission_id=93000 + fiscal_period,
+        cgac_code=cgac_code,
+        reporting_fiscal_year=fiscal_year,
+        reporting_fiscal_period=fiscal_period,
+        quarter_format_flag=is_quarter_format,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_get_submission_attributes_links_previous_quarter_with_unmatched_optional_fields():
+    earlier = get_submission_attributes(
+        91001,
+        _submission_data(
+            cgac_code='073',
+            fiscal_year=2017,
+            fiscal_period=3,
+            is_quarter_format=True,
+            frec_code='EARLY',
+        ),
+    )
+
+    later = get_submission_attributes(
+        91002,
+        _submission_data(
+            cgac_code='073',
+            fiscal_year=2017,
+            fiscal_period=6,
+            is_quarter_format=True,
+            frec_code='LATER',
+        ),
+    )
+
+    assert later.previous_submission_id == earlier.submission_id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_get_submission_attributes_links_previous_quarter_for_another_reporting_series():
+    earlier = get_submission_attributes(
+        93001,
+        _submission_data('020', 2018, 3, True, 'FIRST'),
+    )
+
+    later = get_submission_attributes(
+        93002,
+        _submission_data('020', 2018, 6, True, 'SECOND'),
+    )
+
+    assert later.previous_submission_id == earlier.submission_id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_previous_submission_uses_nearest_valid_quarter_in_reporting_sequence():
+    first_quarter = get_submission_attributes(92001, _submission_data('073', 2017, 3, True, 'A001'))
+    expected_previous = get_submission_attributes(92002, _submission_data('073', 2017, 6, True, 'A002'))
+
+    different_agency = _submission_record('097', 2017, 8, True)
+    different_year = _submission_record('073', 2018, 8, True)
+    non_quarter = _submission_record('073', 2017, 8, False)
+    later_period = _submission_record('073', 2017, 12, True)
+
+    target = get_submission_attributes(92007, _submission_data('073', 2017, 9, True, 'A007'))
+
+    assert target.previous_submission_id == expected_previous.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != first_quarter.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != different_agency.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != different_year.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != non_quarter.submission_id
+    assert target.previous_submission_id != later_period.submission_id
+
+

--- /dev/null
+++ b/usaspending_api/submissions/tests/test_submission_attributes_serializer.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import pytest
+from django.core.exceptions import FieldDoesNotExist
+from model_mommy import mommy
+
+
+@pytest.mark.django_db
+def test_submissions_endpoint_omits_frec_code_from_output(client):
+    submission_instance = mommy.make(
+        'submissions.SubmissionAttributes',
+        cgac_code='073',
+        reporting_fiscal_year=2017,
+        reporting_fiscal_quarter=2,
+    )
+
+    response = client.get('/api/v1/submissions/')
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert len(response.data['results']) == 1
+
+    submission = response.data['results'][0]
+    assert 'submission_id' in submission
+    assert submission['cgac_code'] == '073'
+    assert submission['reporting_fiscal_year'] == 2017
+    assert submission['reporting_fiscal_quarter'] == 2
+    assert 'frec_code' not in submission
+
+    with pytest.raises(FieldDoesNotExist):
+        submission_instance._meta.get_field('frec_code')
